name: pluto
description: Use TalentPluto's live recruiting workflows, privacy-filtered candidate discovery, bulk external-candidate email enrichment and outbound campaigns, and privacy-thresholded market snapshots through a stable, authenticated Pluto connection.

interface.shortDescription: Use TalentPluto recruiting, outbound, and market tools.
interface.longDescription: Connect once to use TalentPluto's live recruiting, candidate-email enrichment, reviewable outbound campaigns, and market-insight workflows in Codex. Pluto advertises its current tools and input contracts from its MCP server, and consequential actions require explicit user direction.
defaultPrompt: Use Pluto to help with this recruiting task.
Find AI engineers with 1+ years of professional experience in New York.
Find people who match this pasted job description.
Give me a directional US market snapshot for engineering talent.
How many Pluto credits do I have left, and when do they reset?
Ask whether the selected in-network candidate's recorded preference is compatible with a $180,000 annual base salary.
Get and verify the available professional emails for the out-of-network candidates I selected.
Draft a complete three-email campaign for the out-of-network candidates I selected, including the audience, timing, subject, and every message, then let me review it before creation.
Continue with the candidate and role I selected in Pluto.
